theorem_natural_language_statement:
For $n>0$ and independent source lengths $N_L,N_R\le n$, instantiate the source-bank constructor at the actual band size, local half-size, block count, and total size. This estimate charges original-band source reuse to encoder construction without adding a new per-query input scan.
